list: eval/businesses-2.json (12 local businesses never used in rounds 1-2: wedding venues, hotels, dental clinics, a driving school)
checkedBy: Independent re-check outside Proofline on 2026-10-11: dig (DNS), curl (HTTP and HTTPS, page titles, full homepage HTML), openssl s_client (certificate end date), Nominatim free-text search with several name variants and extratags (what kind of place a match is), web search for an own site.

risus.no_own_website: right (risuswedding.com has no DNS record; search shows Yandex Maps and directories only)
risus.on_map: right ('Risus Wedding', Turgut Özal Bulvarı, İncek, Gölbaşı, Ankara)

golden.on_map: right ('Golden Boutique Hotel', Boğaz Sokak, Gaziosmanpaşa, Çankaya, Ankara)

pelops.no_own_website: right (only booking sites: Otelz, Neredekal, Ucuzabilet; no own domain resolves)
pelops.not_on_map: right (OSM's only 'Hotel Pelops' is in Olympia, Greece)

vipgarden.no_own_website: right as stated (vipgardenkirdugunu.com.tr now serves an unrelated betting page, so there is no working site of its own); the more useful finding, that its old domain shows a betting site, was not made
vipgarden.not_on_map: right (OSM's 'Vip Garden' entries are in Rome, Bologna and Moldova)

dentikonya.https_healthy: right (certificate ends 16 Nov 2026 = 36 days; http 301 to https)

hera.no_own_website: right (herabutikhotel.com has no DNS record; search shows booking sites only)

sunset.no_own_website: wrong: sunsetboutiquehotel.com is its own site ('Sunset Boutique Hotel & Apartments - Cirali'); it answers on http only (https fails), so a probe that tries https alone misses it
sunset.not_on_map: wrong: OSM has it as 'Sunset Pansiyon and Apartments', Çıralı, Kemer, Antalya (same place; its site says pansiyon, Çıralı)

sirince.no_own_website: right (sirincebahce.com has no DNS record; booking sites only)

santral.on_map: wrong: the match 'Santral' on Bağcı Caddesi, Keçiören is a clothes shop (shop=clothes), not the dental clinic; the retry without generic words left one word that matches anything

erguvan.site_unreachable: true claim lost, arguably: erguvankasri.com has no DNS record and directories gave it on 5 Oct; nothing in this run's search tied it to the business, so the gate refused to call it the business's site

melina.no_own_website: true claim lost: melinaweddinghouse.com has no DNS record; the identity check could not settle it (possible namesake), which is the cautious outcome

golden.no_own_website: true claim lost, for a wrong reason: golden-boutique.ankarahotels.org is a hotel directory page, not the hotel's own site (goldenboutiquehotel.com.tr has no DNS record)

a2.no_own_website: rightly dropped (a2mtsk.com is its site), but for a wrong reason: aysansurucukursu.com ('Aysan Sürücü Kursu') is another school; only the generic words 'Sürücü Kursu' matched

santral.no_own_website: rightly dropped (santralankara.com is linked from its Instagram)
